title: Extra-cost features, power, and space
summary: This topic loosely groups comments about paying extra, added features or power, and extra cabin or cargo room, with many fragments too context-limited to determine sentiment clearly.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention enjoying added power and valuing the possibility of extra room.

negative.summary: Negative feedback focuses on an added service visit cost that the customer considered unreasonable.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention paid options, extra features, extra range, extra sound, and extra space, but the short excerpts do not provide enough context to classify sentiment reliably.

limitations: The cluster mixes several loosely related subjects, including added costs, optional features, performance, artificial sound, and interior or cargo space.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined because they are brief and lack enough context for reliable sentiment classification.
The examples are stratified samples and should not be treated as representative of all G60 reviews.
